product.tagline: 把 AI 生成内容锻造成可验收的 Office 文档。
product.description: 围绕私有模板、AI 交接、内容校验和本地渲染，把结构化内容安全生成 PPTX、DOCX 与 XLSX，并保留可复核的任务历史。
nonGoals: 承担模型推理或托管外部 AI 服务
把私有模板、Logo 或客户内容打包进应用
绕过模板校验直接覆盖已有输出文件

capabilities.title: 私有模板库
capabilities.body: 链接、校验、迁移和自测本地模板包，真实模板与业务素材留在用户选择的目录。

capabilities.title: AI 交接包
capabilities.body: 把模板契约、内容骨架、写作约束和 brief 组合成可交给外部 AI 的完整 prompt。

capabilities.title: 内容验收
capabilities.body: 在生成前检查字段、资源、绑定和模板协议，失败时给出明确修复清单。

capabilities.title: 多格式渲染
capabilities.body: 统一生成 PPTX、DOCX、XLSX 或脚本型输出，并在替换目标文件前验证结构完整性。

capabilities.title: 任务与历史
capabilities.body: 保留轻量任务阶段和生成记录，方便继续、重新生成、打开或定位输出。

capabilities.title: Agent CLI
capabilities.body: 通过稳定 JSON 信封准备交接包、校验内容、渲染文档并输出机器可读报告。

workflow.label: 准备
workflow.title: 链接模板与业务 brief
workflow.body: 选择本地模板包，让应用读取 manifest、输入协议和模板作者说明。

workflow.label: 交接
workflow.title: 生成内容契约
workflow.body: 复制交接 prompt，获取符合模板约束的 JSON 或 Markdown 内容。

workflow.label: 验收
workflow.title: 在本机校验输入
workflow.body: 先检查 schema、资源和绑定关系，再决定是否进入渲染。

workflow.label: 生成
workflow.title: 安全写出 Office 文件
workflow.body: 通过事务文件完成生成与结构检查，成功后再替换目标输出。

boundary.title: 模板与业务内容留在本机
boundary.body: rDeckForge 不承担模型推理，也不把真实模板、Logo 或客户内容打进应用。SQLite 只保存路径、任务阶段、校验摘要和生成历史，不复制业务文档正文。

website.releaseSummary: 0.1.5 预览版覆盖 AI 交接、模板管理、内容验收、多格式渲染、任务历史与 JSON CLI。

product.tagline: Forge AI-authored content into reviewable Office documents.
product.description: Use private templates, AI handoff contracts, local validation, and deterministic rendering to turn structured content into PPTX, DOCX, and XLSX files with reviewable task history.
nonGoals: Run model inference or host an external AI service
Bundle private templates, logos, or customer content with the app
Overwrite an existing output before template and document validation succeeds

capabilities.title: Private template library
capabilities.body: Link, validate, migrate, and test local template packs while real templates and business assets remain in user-selected directories.

capabilities.title: AI handoff packages
capabilities.body: Combine template contracts, content skeletons, writing constraints, and a brief into a complete prompt for an external AI.

capabilities.title: Content acceptance
capabilities.body: Check fields, assets, bindings, and template protocols before rendering, with an actionable repair list when validation fails.

capabilities.title: Multi-format rendering
capabilities.body: Generate PPTX, DOCX, XLSX, or script-driven outputs and validate document structure before replacing the destination file.

capabilities.title: Tasks and history
capabilities.body: Keep lightweight task stages and generation records so work can be resumed, regenerated, opened, or located.

capabilities.title: Agent CLI
capabilities.body: Prepare handoff packages, validate content, render documents, and return machine-readable reports through stable JSON envelopes.

workflow.label: Prepare
workflow.title: Link a template and brief
workflow.body: Choose a local template pack and let the app read its manifest, input protocol, and authoring guidance.

workflow.label: Handoff
workflow.title: Build the content contract
workflow.body: Copy the generated handoff prompt and receive JSON or Markdown content that follows the template constraints.

workflow.label: Validate
workflow.title: Review input locally
workflow.body: Check schemas, assets, and binding relationships before allowing content into the renderer.

workflow.label: Generate
workflow.title: Write Office files safely
workflow.body: Render into a transactional file, validate its structure, and replace the destination only after checks succeed.

boundary.title: Templates and business content stay local
boundary.body: rDeckForge does not run model inference and does not bundle real templates, logos, or customer content. SQLite stores paths, task stages, validation summaries, and generation history rather than business document copies.

website.releaseSummary: The 0.1.5 preview includes AI handoff packages, template management, content acceptance, multi-format rendering, task history, and a JSON CLI.
